import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_58/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_58/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "city"
# Join Source2_58_0 and Source2_58_1 on the "city" column
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by on Source2_58_1.type
# Aggregations:
# sum(Source2_58_0.fare) -> sum of 'fare' from df0
# max(Source2_58_0.ride_id) -> max of 'ride_id' from df0
# sum(Source2_58_1.driver_count) -> sum of 'driver_count' from df1

# Group by 'type' column from Source2_58_1 (which is now in df_joined)
grouped = df_joined.groupby('type').agg({
    'fare': 'sum',
    'ride_id': 'max',
    'driver_count': 'sum'
}).reset_index()

# Ensure the target schema and types:
# ['type': string, 'fare': float, 'ride_id': integer, 'driver_count': integer]

grouped['type'] = grouped['type'].astype(str)
grouped['fare'] = grouped['fare'].astype(float)
grouped['ride_id'] = grouped['ride_id'].astype('int64')
grouped['driver_count'] = grouped['driver_count'].astype('int64')

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_58/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
